www.corpx.com/business:
CorpX Business

[CorpX Works] Work collaboration solution
E-approval, attendance management, the internal messenger and a document box on one screen. The internal messenger on this PC is also CorpX Works.
- Over 1,800 customers, about 210,000 daily users
- Available as cloud and on-premises versions
- Version 4.0 released in June 2024: message read receipts and typing indicators, mobile approval

[CorpX Pay] Payment processing service
Card payments, bank transfers and settlement reports for online stores and businesses.
- 10,000 merchants, about KRW 120 billion in monthly payment volume
- The payment module and settlement system are built and operated directly by Dev Team 2
- Registered as an electronic financial business, holds information security management certification

[Main Customers]
Manufacturing and retail companies, local governments and hospitals use CorpX products.
Inquiries: sales@corpx.com

CorpX Notices

[Must read] Guidance on organizing documents for the regular inspection
Ahead of the regulator's regular inspection, please organize the documents each department keeps. Direct questions to the Executive Office.

[Security] Beware of phishing emails and messenger messages
External emails asking for internal account information have increased recently. The Security Team does not ask for passwords by email or messenger. If you receive a similar contact, do not reply and report it to the Information Security Team.

[Info] Intranet password policy
Please change your password regularly according to your department's notice.

[Info] Internal messenger 4.0 update
The CorpX Works messenger has been updated to 4.0. The number 1 disappears when the other person reads your message, and "typing" is shown while they are writing a reply.

[Event] CEO birthday celebration event
The Executive Office will announce the details separately.

[Benefits] Fall health checkup applications
Applications are taken by the General Affairs Team of the Management Support Division until the end of November. You can take a half-day on the day of your checkup.

Basement level 3 will be unavailable this Saturday and Sunday.

CorpX Press Releases

[2024.10.21] CorpX Pay passes 10,000 merchants
The payment processing service CorpX Pay now has more than 10,000 merchants. It took 10 years since the service launched in 2014. The company plans to expand its settlement report features by next year.

[2024.09.02] Induction ceremony for second-half open recruitment new hires
The new hires chosen through the second-half open recruitment completed their induction ceremony and were assigned to their departments.

[2024.06.17] CorpX Works 4.0 released, adds read receipts to the messenger
The work collaboration solution CorpX Works 4.0 is out. The internal messenger now has read receipts and typing indicators, and approvals can be made directly from a mobile phone.

[2024.03.11] CEO Kang Taeho receives commendation for digital transformation of small businesses
CEO Kang Taeho received a commendation for helping small businesses computerize their operations.

[2023.12.04] Passed 400 employees
CorpX now has more than 400 employees. The Development Division grew 30% from last year.
